cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Prove Your Loyalty
cards.instruction: Invent small tests of loyalty and judge every response without admitting there is a test.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll have the move organized before Friday. Can I put you down as my first call for carrying boxes?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already promised Alex I'd help paint.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Alex first. Good to know where the day stands. I'll keep the heavy work flexible if you leave your phone on.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. But have you actually found a flat yet?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Still choosing. A charged phone is a useful start; I'll put you under available rather than confirmed. Nothing personal, just keeping the plan tidy.
